headline: Google Home update improves Nest speakers and fixes bugs
summary: The latest Google Home and Gemini update brings smoother audio playback, more reliable voice commands, and fixes for alarm volumes and device control.
details: Google has released a new update for Gemini for Home and the Google Home app, bringing significant improvements to Nest and Google Home speakers. The update focuses on enhancing streaming performance and delivering smoother audio playback, aiming to reduce issues like boomy bass and improve clarity at lower volumes.

Voice commands are now more reliable, with Gemini better understanding requests to move music between rooms and fewer "Sorry, I did not understand" responses. The YouTube TV experience on smart displays also benefits from improved voice command recognition.

The update addresses a critical bug that could set alarm and timer volumes to zero, ensuring they now match the device volume. It also fixes unpredictable volume controls, preventing unintended adjustments on nearby speakers when a specific device is targeted.

Practical improvements are also coming to the Google Home app. On Android, it now recognizes specific Matter closure types like garage doors and gates, displaying correct icons and controls. Matter smart plugs and energy monitors will show real-time and cumulative power usage.
For thermostats, a new shortcut allows quick switching to an energy-saving temperature. Android foldable phone users will experience a better camera live view when folding or unfolding their devices.

The Chromecast with Google TV HD and 4K are receiving the August 2026 security patch, along with connectivity, streaming, and display enhancements. Nest Wifi routers and points get improved mesh network resilience and stability.

Older Nest cameras migrated to Google Home see better Wi-Fi reconnection, faster night vision activation, and resolved audio sync issues. Nest Hello doorbells gain improved person and Familiar Face detection, while Nest Cam IQ models receive a status light fix.
